text:
White to move. Force Black's rook to build the smothered mate box

The g8 square is covered by both White's queen on b3 and knight on e7.

Calculate the 2-move finish ♟️

#Chess #SpeedChess #ChessTactics

creative.headline:
PHILIDOR'S LEGACY
*QUEEN SAC IN 2*
creative.subhead: White to move • Forced Mate in 2
creative.footer: Answer with reactions or in replies.

docked_reply.text:
Solution: 1. Qg8+! Rxg8 2. Nf7# (Philidor's Legacy).
Black's king cannot take on g8 because e7 guards it, forcing Rxg8.
